description_short: Rescues trucks that are stuck with their load: schedules the game's own vehicle recovery (flat 0.2 Unity, cargo preserved aboard) when a truck is flagged cannot-deliver or repeatedly fails navigation, under hard guards (vanilla depot/Unity gate pre-checked, Unity reserve floor, daily cap). Optional stage 2 empties a load that is still undeliverable after a rescue into the game's storage routing. Requires QoSCore. Ships disabled; enable it in the mod settings.
display_name: QoS Vehicle Recovery — stuck truck cargo rescue
